peerGroup.rule: same class (condo), market segment (RCR) and lease-age group; original lease 99 years or longer

positions.label: Resale activity
positions.statement: Resale activity — Around peers (52.0): 3.1 resales per 100 homes a year (24 months): higher than 198 of 393 similar developments with a figure (the same as 13). Context, not scored: resales in 12.5% of months (24 months).

comparisonGroup.rule: same class (condo), market segment (RCR) and lease-age group; original lease 99 years or longer

profile.rule: Each line compares this development with its own comparison group; numbers from different groups are not comparable. There is no overall score.
profile.surroundingMarket: Surrounding market: other condo and EC developments within 2 km (straight line between development positions); new sales plus resales; subsales, cluster and other landed housing, HDB flats and this development are excluded. Competition, the quiet-area check and the Market backdrop use this same set.

lines.label: Entry price against comparable developments

missing.reason: too few comparable resales for a price comparison

lines.statement: Not available: too few comparable resales for a price comparison.

lines.label: Sustained resale activity
lines.statement: No first resale wave in the observation period: sustained activity is the observed activity.

lines.label: MRT today
lines.statement: Bendemeer MRT about 420 m, Farrer Park MRT about 430 m; closer than 428 of 662 similar developments (the same as 5). Straight-line distances.

lines.label: Primary schools
lines.statement: 0 within 1 km and 5 within 2 km; nearest Farrer Park Primary School about 1,020 m; more than 0 of 662 similar developments (the same as 125). Straight-line distances. MOE measures distance for school admission differently.

lines.label: Everyday amenities
lines.statement: 10 supermarkets within 1 km (nearest about 340 m), more than 426 of 662 similar developments (the same as 86); nearest hawker centre Berseh Food Centre about 580 m; nearest park Kallang Riverside Park about 680 m. Straight-line distances.

lines.label: Future transport
lines.statement: Not yet assessed: needs official LTA evidence for planned stations.

lines.label: Recorded new-launch competition
lines.statement: 8 other condo developments sold new homes within 2 km (Piccadilly Grand, 1 new sales, about 860 m; Aurea, 39 new sales, about 1,150 m; The Arcady at Boon Keng, 32 new sales, about 1,370 m; Duet @ Emily, 3 new sales, about 1,420 m; Midtown Modern, 1 new sales, about 1,490 m; The Collective at One Sophia, 16 new sales, about 1,650 m; Midtown Bay, 4 new sales, about 1,720 m; Orchard Sophia, 13 new sales, about 1,790 m). Surrounding market, Oct 2025–Sep 2026: 252 other condo and EC developments within 2 km recorded 109 new sales and 771 resales (880 purchases); new sales were 12.4% of these purchases. Subsales (40) and this development’s own transactions are excluded. New sales as a share of local private purchases is a measure of market activity, not of supply pressure.

lines.label: Quiet-area check
lines.statement: Not a quiet area. 771 resales within 2 km in Oct 2025–Sep 2026, more than 331 of 662 similar developments.

lines.label: Market backdrop
lines.statement: Condo and EC resales within 2 km: 771 in Oct 2025–Sep 2026 against 828 in Oct 2024–Sep 2025 (−6.9%). Planning-area private resales −11.3%. Observed transactions, not a prediction.
